reviews.text: We will be contacting R&R Chimney Repair and Chimney Inspection in Hookstown going forward! During the chimney inspection, Lucas was amiable, informed, and able to respond to any of our inquiries. They did a great job repairing the chimney.

reviews.text: For a fireplace inspection and cleaning, I called R&R Chimney cleaning and Refrigeration, and they provided great service. The specialist finished a comprehensive assessment and gave an upfront explanation of the cost of the chimney inspection.

reviews.text: My expectations were surpassed by R&R Chimney cleaning and Refrigeration chimney inspection service. Before starting, the expert thoroughly examined the cost of the chimney inspection and came on schedule.
